description: Read-only public DLsite work, review, search, price, rating, and maker research.

interface.shortDescription: Research public DLsite works, reviews, prices, ratings, and makers.

defaultPrompt: Find this DLsite work and summarize its public metadata.
Read this DLsite work's public reviews and continue through every page.
Search DLsite for this title and compare the results.
Check this DLsite work's KRW price, rating, and creators.
